visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot features a hand using silver tongs to pick up a round, sugar-dusted donut from a crowded metal tray. The scene is brightly lit within a commercial food counter setting. (2) The camera transitions to a extreme close-up of a bitten donut being held by fingers, revealing a thick, pale yellow custard filling inside the soft dough. (3) A hand holds two donuts in paper wrappers, showcasing them against the background of a modern shopping mall hallway with shoppers walking by. (4) A wide shot captures a long queue of customers waiting in a brightly lit department store corridor, indicating high demand. (5) A close-up shows a green piping bag dispensing thick pistachio cream into the centers of multiple donuts arranged neatly on a tray. (6) A hand uses a small metal measuring spoon to sprinkle finely crushed green nuts onto the piped pistachio cream. (7) Several quick cuts show donuts being torn or squeezed, demonstrating the soft texture and the variety of fillings including matcha, chocolate, and vanilla. (8) A white insulated shopping bag with a small green brand sticker is held up and displayed in front of a promotional poster in the mall. (9) Staff members in yellow uniforms are seen working behind a counter, boxing the donuts for customers. (10) The video concludes with a hand holding a single chocolate-topped donut, with the mall background softly out of focus.
